claim: Increasing the effective batch size in token-efficient RL leads to significant performance degradation, likely due to less frequent policy updates.
falsifier: Vary effective batch size in token-efficient RL on a different task; if larger batch size reduces performance, the claim is supported.

exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported system (Qwen2-1.5B), tasks (SV AMP and multi-digit multiplication), and batch size increase from an unspecified baseline to 8; transfer beyond these conditions is unestablished.

title: Increasing effective batch size–performance degradation principle
